description: CDL-PLC is a Python translator from Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory and the University of Wuppertal for transferring building-control sequences to programmable logic controllers. It accepts a CXF JSON-LD representation produced by modelica-json and writes the IEC 61131-10 XML exchange format for import into a PLC development environment. The README provides a three-step conversion workflow and lists the supported logical, conversion and real-valued control blocks. Public source is free under modified three-clause BSD terms. Coverage is the supplied control sequence, without a fixed building location, observation period or time resolution. Its main limitation is incomplete CDL coverage: the implementation demonstrates translation feasibility for selected blocks, not the entire language. The documented compatibility is modelica-json 1.2.0 and XML import in Beremiz 1.4-rc1. Users must check broader version or block combinations. The tool helps transfer simulated building controls towards implementation and is related to the catalogue's Modelica Buildings library (model-modelica-buildings-library), which supplies Modelica/CDL control descriptions. Translation and controller behaviour were not executed or verified in this review.
